name: Jebusites
overview: The Jebusites were one of the Canaanite tribes inhabiting the land promised by God to Abraham and his descendants, described as a land flowing with milk and honey (Exodus 3:8, 3:17; Genesis 15:21). Though God commanded their destruction to prevent idolatry (Exodus 23:23-24), the Jebusites were not completely exterminated but instead intermarried with the Israelites. Their territory included Jerusalem, which was conquered by David, and later they paid tribute to Solomon, reflecting their continued presence and integration within Israel's history.
